subject: Modifying a bias .nc file for ABMD

messages.author: Michael Bruist
messages.body:
I would like to make modifications to a bias file and then use that as the starting bias for a new abmd run. I am not able to create a file with the correct .nc format. Can nfe-umbrella-slice convert ascii to .nc? I have tried ncgen, but the file created is not recognized by abmd.
Thank you for your help.
Michael F. Bruist
Professor of Biochemistry, Emeritus
Department of Chemistry and Biochemistry
St. Joseph’s University
